title: Machine learning-based high-throughput screening of metal-organic frameworks for ppb-level acetone capture in semiconductor environment

screen.tldr: Uses machine learning to screen metal-organic frameworks for ultra-trace acetone capture in semiconductor settings, aiming to identify high-performing adsorbent candidates.
screen.transfer_note: High-throughput ML screening workflows and adsorption-property ranking could transfer to prioritizing porous crystal candidates in materials discovery.

title: Strain‐Engineered Fluoro‐Perovskites CsGeF 3 and CsSnF 3 for Efficient and Sustainable Solar Energy Conversion
summary: Although halogenated perovskites have been extensively studied for solar photovoltaic applications, fluorinated perovskites remain largely unexplored. In this context, we perform a first‐principles comparative study of the fluoro‐perovskite materials CsGeF 3 and CsSnF 3 . By applying hydrostatic compressive strains of 2% and 4%, we modulate their electronic structure. The results reveal a significant reduction in the band gap under 4% compressive stress, reaching 1.9 eV for CsGeF 3 and 1.32 eV for CsSnF 3 , which improves their suitability for visible‐light absorption. Additionally, the absorption coefficient in the visible range is strongly enhanced, indicating better light‐harvesting capabilities. Photovoltaic efficiencies, evaluated using the spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency model, increase from 10.96% to 23.28% for CsGeF 3 and from 25.19% to 30.64% for CsSnF 3 under 4% compression, confirming their promising potential as solar absorbers. These findings demonstrate that strain engineering is an effective strategy to tune the electronic and optical properties of fluoroperovskites, offering a practical pathway towards more efficient and sustainable solar energy conversion.

screen.tldr: First-principles strain study of fluoroperovskites CsGeF3 and CsSnF3 shows band-gap reduction and improved photovoltaic metrics under compression.

title: Magnetic field induction and doping synergy enable efficient and stable perovskite solar cells
